title: Organisation Validation Reuse Credit
content:
**Validation team credit schedule — SSL/TLS Certificates, second-key orders on OV and EV products.**

When a customer orders a second-key subscription — a further subscription of the same product, common name and number of extra names as an active subscription the customer already holds (the sibling), for another server that needs its own key — the organisation validation already completed on the sibling can be reused. The second-key order then carries a validation reuse credit:

| Sibling product | Age of the sibling's organisation validation on the order date | Validation reuse credit on the second-key order |
|---|---|---|
| EV product (Harborline EV Single Domain, Harborline EV Multi-Domain) | no more than 398 days old | EV validation reuse credit, USD 60.00 |
| OV product (Harborline OV Single Domain, Harborline OV Wildcard) | no more than 398 days old | OV validation reuse credit, USD 35.00 |
| EV or OV product | more than 398 days old | none |
| DV product | (no organisation validation is performed) | none |

The age is the number of calendar days from the date the sibling's organisation validation last completed, as recorded on the sibling subscription, to the order date of the second-key order. The 398 days is the organisation validation reuse period of the OV and EV products; the DV products have a reuse period of 0 days because they carry no organisation validation.

**Both sides of the limit.**

- The sibling's organisation validation completed 398 days before the order date: the validation is no more than 398 days old, and the credit applies.
- It completed 399 days before the order date: the validation is older than 398 days, and no validation reuse credit applies.
- It completed on the order date itself (0 days old): the credit applies.

**Hypothetical cases.**

- A sibling on Harborline EV Multi-Domain whose organisation validation completed 145 days before the order date: the second-key order carries USD 60.00.
- A sibling on Harborline OV Single Domain validated 412 days before the order date: no validation reuse credit.
- A sibling on Harborline DV Wildcard: no validation reuse credit, whatever its dates.

The validation reuse credit is a fixed credit in US dollars.
